GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 6 lengths. moved up turn looking for run. held up early in Straight . got split 200 metres. ran on well late # not best luck
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rounding the home turn was held up for clear running until after passing the 250m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok well back Settled Down last 14 Lengths 800m last 10 Lengths home turn last Middle Of Track ran on well final 200m # last/ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly and from a wide barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 5 lengths. looking for run turn 2 lengths. weakened in Straight # Ordinary Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported that the mare, which was racing first-up today, failed to quicken on the Heavy 10 surface and will take benefit from the run. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back to last 8l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well # ran on from last
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly throughout the early stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 8 lengths. well back turn. held up down Straight . got to outside 100 metres. # not best luck
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the middle stages of the event. Was held up for clear running until approaching the 100m when shifted to the outside of a runner to continue into clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 6 lengths. well back turn getting to outside. ran on strongly # went well
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. looking for run turn 3 lengths. held up early in Straight . got late split to run on well # not best luck
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Overraced in the early and middle stages of the event. Held up rounding the home turn and until passing the 300m after attempting a narrow run.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. got to outside turn 2 lengths. battled away in Straight # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 2 lengths. looking for run turn 2 lengths. held up early in Straight . held up again 200 metres. ran on well late # not much luck
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping made contact with runner. Approaching the 150m, was directed to the outside of runner after that runner shifted in slightly, in order to obtain clear running. When questioned regarding her riding in the early part of the home straight and why she did not improve into an available run near the 300m. Rider explained that a run did develop near the 300m however she anticipated runner, which had shifted ground out slightly, would shift back in. She said for this reason she elected to improve around that horse to ensure her mounts momentum was not interrupted.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped fairly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield on inside (5L from lead). Stayed same until improving slowly on inside from 500m. Pushed out 3 Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Raced tight & hampered @ 300m & held up until got gap @ 100m. Sprinted well in last 100m to get up on line. # Overcame difficulty
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear running until passing the 200m when shifted outwards to obtain a tight run.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat rail 6l off, off rail turn, Straightened Up 4l off, running on took over 200m and drew clear # just too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 1000m commenced to race keenly when the tempo of the race had slackened.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased from barrier 10 lengths. last turn. hooked very Wide in Straight . ran on strongly # good from barrier.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was bumped and taken wider rounding the home turn. Was carried wider in the home straight.
